```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(raster)
library(dplyr)

```

This masks all variables (i.e., P, T, SM, ET, PET) using the snow grid area created in the previous step
```{r masking all images}

files <- list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/1_individual_files/Monthly VPD/",full.names = TRUE) #change here for the variable you need to mask

for (file in files) {
  
  tmp <- raster(file)
  print(file)
  month <- strsplit(strsplit(file,"_")[[1]][6],".tif")[[1]][1] 
  print(month)
  mask <- raster(paste0("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/2_average_clims/SWE_avg_clim/",month,".tif",sep=""))
  masked <- mask(tmp,mask,maskvalue=NA)
  name <- strsplit(file,"/")[[1]][7]
  writeRaster(masked,paste0("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/3_snow_grid_masked_area/VPD/masked_",name,sep=""),overwrite=TRUE) #change here for the variable folder you masked
  
}

```

Creates the 6 month average
```{r averaging winter groupings}
patterns = seq(1959,2022,by=1) #cant use 1958 or 2023 because they are incomplete water years
avg_files <- as.data.frame(list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/3_snow_grid_masked_area/VPD/",full.names = TRUE)) #change here for variable
names(avg_files) <- "File"
avg_files$year <- as.numeric(substr(avg_files$File,83,86)) #swe 83,86; precip 86,89; temp 85,88; aet 83,86; sm 83,86
avg_files$month <- as.numeric(substr(avg_files$File,88,89)) #swe 88,89; precip 91,92; temp 90,91; aet 88,89; sm 88,89

#1/17/25 changed this to >10 because only using November to April  
avg_files$wy <- ifelse(avg_files$month > 10, avg_files$year+1, avg_files$year) 
northern_months <- c(11,12,1,2,3,4)
avg_files$hem <- ifelse(avg_files$month %in% northern_months, "Northern","Southern")

for (year in patterns) {
  
  year_files <- avg_files[grep(year,avg_files$wy),]
  north <- year_files %>% filter(hem == "Northern")
  north_rast <- calc(stack(north$File),fun=mean,na.rm=TRUE)
  writeRaster(north_rast,paste0("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/4_average_yearly/northern/VPD/",year,".tif",sep="")) #change here for variable
    
}

```

only need to do this once
calculating the normal as the average of all years (1959-2022)
```{r making winter 6 month normals}

monthly <- list.files("F:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/2_average_clims/Tavg_avg_clim/",full.names=TRUE) #change name of variable here

north <- calc(stack(monthly[c(11,12,1,2,3,4)]),fun=mean,na.rm=TRUE)
writeRaster(north,"F:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/5_winter_normals/northern/temp.tif") #change name of variable here
south <- calc(stack(monthly[c(5,6,7,8,9,10)]),fun=mean,na.rm=TRUE)  
writeRaster(south,"F:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/5_winter_normals/southern/temp.tif") #change name of variable here

```


EVERYTHIGN BELOW HERE IS FOR BUDYKO SPECIFIC STUFF
Only need to do this for PET, AET, and Precip
This is doing the same thing but with the aggregated grid created in an earlier step
```{r}
var_file <- list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/1_individual_files/Monthly P/",full.names = TRUE)
mask <- raster("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/aggregate_snow_area.tif")
#masking everything using the same grid

for (file in var_file) {
  
  tmp <- raster(file)
  print(file)
  masked <- mask(tmp,mask,maskvalue=0)
  name <- strsplit(file,"/")[[1]][7]
  writeRaster(masked,paste0("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/8_budyko_files/aggregate_snow_grid_masked/a_individual/Precip/",name,sep="")) #change here for the variable folder you masked
  
}


```

1/17/25 making a full yearly grouping for the Budyko analysis. This is different than the above two chunks because I am averaging the whole year (october to september now) for the AET, PET, and P in order to calculate the full yearly budyko.
Only need this for PET, AET, and P. ONly doing this for the northern hemisphere.

```{r}

patterns = seq(1959,2022,by=1) #cant use 1958 or 2023 because they are incomplete for both the northern and southern hem water years
# avg_files <- as.data.frame(list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/3_snow_grid_masked_area/Precip/",full.names = TRUE)) #change here for variable; this is for the monthly snow grid
avg_files <- as.data.frame(list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/8_budyko_files/aggregate_snow_grid_masked/a_individual/PET/",full.names = TRUE)) #change here for variable; this is for the aggregated grid (same one for whole year)
names(avg_files) <- "File"
avg_files$year <- as.numeric(substr(avg_files$File,107,110)) # precip 110,113; pet&aet 107,110
avg_files$month <- as.numeric(substr(avg_files$File,112,113)) #precip 115,116; pet&aet 112,113

#whole northern hem water year  
avg_files$wy <- ifelse(avg_files$month > 9, avg_files$year+1, avg_files$year) 

#if just using the winter months, use these lines below and then change the folder you're saving to
northern_months <- c(11,12,1,2,3,4)
avg_files$hem <- ifelse(avg_files$month %in% northern_months, "Northern","Southern")
avg_files <- avg_files %>% filter(hem == "Northern")

for (year in patterns) {
  year_files <- avg_files[grep(year,avg_files$wy),]
  north_rast <- calc(stack(year_files$File),fun=mean,na.rm=TRUE)
  writeRaster(north_rast,paste0("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/8_budyko_files/aggregate_snow_grid_masked/b_temporal_aggregates/ii_cold_season/PET/",year,".tif",sep="")) #change here for variable and folder
    
}


```
